title: To designate the community based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs located at 1961 Premier Drive in Mankato, Minnesota, as the "Lyle C. Pearson Community Based Outpatient Clinic".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the community based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) located at 1961 Premier Drive in Mankato, Minnesota, as the "Lyle C. Pearson Community Based Outpatient Clinic."

summary.headline: A 2014 law renamed a VA outpatient clinic in Mankato, Minnesota, after a man named Lyle C. Pearson.
summary.what_it_does: The law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs clinic at 1961 Premier Drive in Mankato, Minnesota, a new official name: the Lyle C. Pearson Community Based Outpatient Clinic. It is a naming measure only. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the renaming took effect on that date.
